verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents user and session tracking, and cost dashboards that break spend down by models, tags, or users. The Metrics API v2 and custom dashboards let developers query aggregate cost and usage, so the core of per-user and per-feature attribution (via tags) is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of attributing cost through arbitrary custom metadata fields, an explicit session-level cost breakdown, and independent or hands-on corroboration of attribution workflows.
